We're looking for enthusiastic teammates skilled in frontend/backend development, UI/UX design, or presentation to collaborate, innovate, and build a winning solution together!
summary:
SPECTRION is an interactive space mission design and simulation game developed using Unity. It allows players to experience the key stages of planning and evaluating a scientific space mission.

Players begin by selecting scientific objectives and configuring a spacecraft using suitable scientific instruments, wavelength bands, and telescope optical systems. The game provides compatibility checks and resource tracking, including payload mass and power consumption. Players then proceed through a launch sequence and receive mission evaluation results based on scientific performance and configuration constraints.

SPECTRION includes three progressive mission levels inspired by the capabilities and scientific goals of historical NASA missions such as Kepler, Hubble, and the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST).

The project aims to make complex aerospace engineering concepts more accessible and engaging through interactive gameplay. It encourages players to understand how scientific goals, spacecraft design, engineering limitations, and mission decisions are connected.

The game is developed using Unity and C#. Its creative approach combines scientific concepts, 3D spacecraft visualization, interactive mission configuration, engineering validation, launch simulation, and mission performance evaluation in a single learning experience.
